subject: Error: at least 1 station has more than 1 item in CTtable.

messages.author: c8bb043da0e9c42e
messages.subject: Error: at least 1 station has more than 1 item in CTtable.
parts:
I am a big fan of camtrapR and have been using this package for almost a year. I have run these codes before and have got camera operation matrix, however I am getting an error this time.

camop_problem <- cameraOperation(CTtable = Camdet4,
                                 stationCol = "Station",
                                 setupCol = "Date_set",
                                 retrievalCol = "Date_retriv",
                                 writecsv = FALSE,
                                 hasProblems = TRUE,
                                 dateFormat = "%d-%m-%Y")

> str(Camdet4)

 $ Camera_no.   : Factor w/ 81 levels ""," C-32 ","Assum",..: 17 10 2 18 19 5 7 35 37 30 ...

 $ Date_retriv  : Factor w/ 42 levels "","01-06-2019",..: 39 18 36 18 36 20 5 16 7 7 ...
 $ Problem1_from: Factor w/ 31 levels "","01-04-2019",..: 1 28 1 26 5 26 7 1 1 1 ...
 $ Problem1_to  : Factor w/ 25 levels "","07-11-2018",..: 1 22 1 22 2 22 21 1 1 1 ...
 $ Problem2_from: Factor w/ 15 levels "","02-04-2019",..: 1 6 1 5 10 1 8 1 1 1 ...
 $ Problem2_to  : Factor w/ 13 levels "","02-06-2019",..: 1 8 1 8 12 1 5 1 1 1 ...

Error: at least 1 station has more than 1 item in CTtable. Please specify 'cameraCol' or 'sessionCol'

I have one camera per station that was in some cases (approx 30) repeated after a gap of around 2 months. But never had two cameras operating simultaneously in one station. 

Any help will be highly appreciated.

messages.author: 801722d43588a5ba
messages.subject: Re: Error: at least 1 station has more than 1 item in CTtable.
parts:
Hi Avantika,

If you have a camera column then you need to specify that as an argument in cameraOperation script. Also, some of your stations were repeated after a gap of 2 months so it may be a possibility that the package is counting that particular station as a duplicate row (especially, without camera column). 

cameraOperation(CTtable, stationCol = "Station", cameraCol, sessionCol, setupCol, retrievalCol, hasProblems = FALSE, byCamera, allCamsOn, camerasIndependent, dateFormat = "%Y-%m-%d", writecsv = FALSE, outDir) 

- Saloni

messages.author: c8bb043da0e9c42e
messages.subject: Re: Error: at least 1 station has more than 1 item in CTtable.
parts:
Thank you Saloni. 
Finally these codes worked. 

camop_problem<- cameraOperation(CTtable = dat,
                                stationCol = "Station",
                                cameraCol = "Camno",
                                hasProblem = TRUE,
                                byCamera = FALSE,
                                allCamsOn = TRUE,

writecsv = TRUE,
                                dateFormat = "%d-%m-%Y",
                                outDir = "F:/R data set/unmarked 2, naive occu")
